entities.name: Bifunctional Nnr
observations: Reviewed homologs Q83CM5, P31806, and Q9KMX5 are annotated as bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes.
The N-terminal YjeF-like module supports NAD(P)HX epimerase activity; the C-terminal module supports ADP-dependent dehydration of (S)-NAD(P)HX.
Annotated reactions include (6R)-NAD(P)HX epimerization to (6S)-NAD(P)HX and ADP-dependent dehydration of (6S)-NAD(P)HX to regenerate NAD(P)H, producing AMP and phosphate.
Reviewed homologs bind one K+ ion per subunit; corresponding EC numbers are 5.1.99.6 and 4.2.1.136.
Associated GO terms include NAD(P)HX epimerase activity, ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity, metabolite repair, and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.
